description: "The Culprit Fay, and Other Poems by Joseph Rodman Drake" is a collection of poems written in the early 19th century, during the Romantic era.
longDescription: The book features a variety of works, with a central focus on themes of nature, love, and the supernatural, embodying the essence of the literary movements of its time.

authorInfo.bio: Joseph Rodman Drake (1795–1820) wrote The Culprit Fay, and Other Poems. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
